title: Define deterministic isolated runner admission and enforcement
goal: Specify the first EVA-03 runner boundary without exposing unconfined execution
acceptance: Define threat model and fixed job admission using existing NERV grants, exact arguments, deadlines and least EVA class; do not add a second approval authority
Specify per-job filesystem mounts, network egress, credentials, process cancellation and CPU/memory/output limits for supported hosts
Keep grader and promotion authority outside candidate writes; preserve failed attempts and uncertain external effects in the ledger
Define escape, credential denial, grader tampering, timeout/cancellation and recovery join tests before enabling execution
Retain pilot/trust-stage prerequisites for execution; contract design can proceed without claiming those prerequisites implemented
privacy: Neutral repository-owned fixtures/design only; no service activation, credentials, model calls or external effects.
validation: Review against existing policy/ledger/worker recovery and F-006 grading contracts
Run applicable documentation/work/backlog checks; no runtime confinement claim
escalation: Unsupported host enforcement or unclear trust boundary blocks execution; do not substitute a worktree or subprocess
New upstream API work belongs to its owning repository; NERV supplies adapters

effort.basis: Estimate added at featurePlans adoption (2026-11-11): deterministic isolated runner admission and enforcement contract. Later steps F-049-T02–T10 planned 2026-11-11. Estimate, not a measurement. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one.
